One photograph, six image models

The same real photograph put through four jobs by each model. Every image below is an unedited first result — one attempt per model, no re-rolls. Hold any image to compare it with the original.

Task 4

Somewhere else again, shot like a phone photo

Originalreal photograph · CC0

In a flat, shot like an ordinary phone photo

A candid snapshot of the same person taken on an ordinary older smartphone, indoors in a lived-in apartment living room with daylight coming through a window. He is wearing a pink knitted beanie and standing with his arms crossed. Same face, same denim jacket and olive t-shirt. Deep depth of field with the whole background in sharp focus, no bokeh, no blurred background. Flat direct on-camera phone lighting, slightly noisy and over-sharpened, visible JPEG compression, imperfect casual framing with the subject slightly off-centre and a bit of empty space above his head. An unremarkable everyday photo, NOT a professional portrait, not cinematic, no shallow depth of field.

fal.ai

Nano Banana Pro Google Gemini 3

API only Proprietary ~$0.06 / img Reference only

Included for reference only. The C2PA manifest inside these files is signed by Google and states, in its own words, that it “applied imperceptible SynthID watermark”. That mark lives in the pixels rather than the metadata, so it survives cropping, resizing and re-encoding, and it cannot be switched off — routing the request through fal does not change this, because Google applies it before the image is handed over. These images are therefore machine-detectable as AI-generated, and we will not be using this model.
